description.purpose: One channel as one hive: the connector that owns the chat's credential, plus the slot its current talky generation occupies. The hive IS the channel -- the identity that stays -- and the talkies inside it are its generations, one active and the older ones silent and preserved (ADR-0002 E7/E8). The generation slot ships occupied by terminal@1.0.0, so every lane of the contract has a destination from the moment of instantiation.
description.use_when: For a chat, room or line whose participant set is worth keeping as a fact -- which is every room with more than two people in it. One instance per bot token: a Telegram token tolerates exactly ONE getUpdates consumer, so a second channel on the same token would take the first one's updates away.
description.not_in_scope: No firewall (shared, in front of all channel hives -- see the README), no memory (the member's memory-hive is a sibling), no tools, no persona, no roster. The generation is NOT baked in: a channel gets its first talky by mutation and its next one when the participant set changes.
examples: LANES IN - in_turn (the screened turn coming back from the shared firewall; the door promotes context.channel_open_history), in_reply (something to say here that the generation did not produce), in_tool / in_advice / in_bundle / in_memory_call (the generation's fan-ins), in_sweep / in_prune / in_round_sweep (the operator lanes).

LANES OUT - turn (the unscreened turn, for the shared firewall, with channel/chat_id/user_id already in context), recall / write / turn_write (the generation's memory lanes), tool (hop.tool_name says which), error (MUST be wired, and required_drains says so).

FIRST GENERATION - one mutation scoped at the channel: add_nodes a talky, then swap_nodes the terminal for it. The swap swings every lane of the slot onto the new node at once, which is also how the SECOND generation arrives -- and the old one stays, disconnected and preserved.
TWO CHANNELS, TWO TOKENS - the second instance is named channel-2 and takes its own credential with override_params on telegram-connector/proxy.
